findings.claim_text: RNA data is available for nearly all samples that have clinical records.

evidence.calculation: samples with RNA and clinical / samples with clinical

findings.limitation: Coverage says nothing about RNA quality or batch effects.
next_actions: Check RNA quality metrics before relying on this coverage.

findings.claim_text: Protein data covers over 90 percent of the cohort.

evidence.calculation: samples with protein / samples with clinical

findings.limitation: Protein panel is smaller than the RNA panel, so coverage per marker may differ.
next_actions: Restrict the question to the 440 samples that have protein data, or drop protein from the analysis.
Report coverage per protein marker instead of one overall number.

findings.claim_text: Mutation and survival data overlap enough to study survival by mutation status.

evidence.calculation: death events among samples with mutation and survival data

findings.limitation: Only 38 events remain after joins, which is thin for subgroup comparisons.
findings.review_reason: Borderline event count; a person should decide whether this is enough for the intended question.

robustness.alt_rule: include samples with partial mutation panels

next_actions: Narrow the question to a broader mutation group so more events remain.
Ask a reviewer whether 38 events is enough for the intended comparison.

findings.claim_text: Drug X improves survival for patients in this dataset.

evidence.calculation: not run: request is a clinical or treatment claim

findings.limitation: This tool checks data readiness only. It does not assess treatment effectiveness.
findings.review_reason: Clinical or treatment claim blocked by event rules.
next_actions: Rewrite the claim as a data-availability question, such as how many samples have treatment records.
Send treatment-effect questions to qualified clinical researchers.

findings.claim_text: Every tumor sample has a matching pathology slide.

evidence.calculation: samples with a barcode-matched slide / samples with clinical

findings.limitation: Slides link only where the barcode matches; frozen and diagnostic slides are counted separately.
next_actions: Limit the analysis to the 842 samples with barcode-matched slides.
Count diagnostic and frozen slides separately.

findings.claim_text: Copy number data and RNA data can be joined for most samples.

evidence.calculation: samples present in both copy number and RNA / samples with clinical

findings.limitation: Join uses sample IDs only; patient-level duplicates were not collapsed.
next_actions: Check duplicate patients before joining at patient level.

findings.claim_text: Samples from patient TCGA-XX-0000 show unusual survival.

evidence.calculation: not run: request targets an individual patient

findings.limitation: Individual-level inference is out of scope for this tool.
findings.review_reason: Request targets a single patient; event rules forbid individual risk or re-identification work.
next_actions: Rewrite the claim as a cohort-level question.

findings.claim_text: The cohort is large enough for a subtype comparison.

evidence.calculation: not run: no subtype column found in the loaded files

findings.limitation: The data cannot answer this: the needed column was not found in the loaded files.
next_actions: Check whether a subtype column exists in another data file, or pick a different grouping.
